mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the previous three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous two months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases > 5% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous two months signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 1% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth above 2.5% over the previous quarter signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is above 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% over the previous quarter, it signals a weak economic environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: weak economic environment with accommodative policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 growth < 1%.
